description: Retrieve an ObjectScript class, routine, CSP page, or include file by name. Pass startLine and/or endLine (1-based, inclusive) to read part of a UDL text document: use a range for large classes, and to read the exact lines before changing them with `iris_doc_edit`, which uses the same line numbers. A ranged read returns the lines numbered (`cat -n` layout: the number right-aligned in 6 columns, a tab, then the line exactly), plus totalLines and the document's version timestamp `ts`; an endLine past the end is clamped to the last line. Use metadataOnly to check existence and get the version timestamp (`etag`) without downloading content. To pull many documents at once, see `iris_doc_export`. To fetch the macro-expanded compiled intermediate of a class by its bare name, see `iris_routine_intermediate`.

endLine.description: Last line to return, 1-based and inclusive (default: the last line when only startLine is given). A value past the end is clamped to the last line.

metadataOnly.description: Boolean (true/false). When true, only check existence and return metadata (the version timestamp, as `etag`) without downloading content

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

startLine.description: First line to return, 1-based and inclusive (default: 1 when only endLine is given). Line 1 is the first element of the document's line array; a class's last line is often empty. Not allowed with metadataOnly or format xml.

name: iris_doc_get
title: Get Document
